capabilities: open .ledger, .ldg, .ldgr, .journal and .hledger files with a click
edit files in a CodeMirror 6 editor with undo/redo, line numbers, multiple cursors and line wrapping
highlight dates, amounts, currencies, accounts, directives and comments using VSCode Dark+/Light+ colors
auto-save after typing stops, on focus loss or on Cmd/Ctrl+S, and toggle read-only mode
reload automatically when files change externally if there are no unsaved edits
extras: Plugin was pending Obsidian community review at the time of writing; manual installation steps are documented for pre-approval use. Color handling includes one documented deviation from the VSCode original: trailing comments no longer wipe the line's keyword and account colors. Documentation is duplicated in Japanese.
intentEvidence: Syntax rules are ported from the VSCode extension vscode-ledger (MIT License)
problem: Obsidian cannot open or color-highlight plain-text accounting files like .ledger or .journal by default.
summary: Viewer and editor for Ledger CLI plain-text accounting files (.ledger, .journal, .hledger) with VSCode-style syntax highlighting.
